why_primary_method_dominates: WhiteHawk's economic claim is a royalty on a finite, depleting physical inventory held through an Up-C, and only a paired owner-cash and unit-NAV method values both what the producing wells pay out and what the undeveloped volumes are worth without counting the same molecules twice. The corroborating methods available in this power zone were considered and are subordinate for stated reasons rather than unavailable. Comparable transactions cannot lead: the packet indexes zero third-party sources, so any multiple would be asserted, not evidenced. Replacement cost or reverse NAV is inapplicable because a mineral interest cannot be rebuilt at cost. A pure owner-cash discount, which is what an earlier revision of this contract actually executed while the route called for the pairing, is precisely the failure the pairing exists to prevent: capitalising a distribution struck before depletion as though it were perpetual earnings. The decisive fact is that pro forma FY2025 depletion of $36.451m is essentially equal to pro forma CAFD of $36.317m, and pro forma net income is a $32.330m loss. No method that ignores the reserve report can value this security correctly. The two legs are not averaged; they value disjoint volumes and are summed, with the contract reporting no double-counting flags.
methods_rejected_for_averaging: The owner-cash and unit-NAV legs were not blended to produce a consensus number. They are additive over a partition of the 206,473 MMcfe proved book into 178,544 MMcfe producing and 27,930 MMcfe non-producing, and each carries its own calculation proof.

The pre-2026-08-10 range of $6.77/$10.15/$21.70 was not averaged with the current range. It was superseded: its high case assumed +2% perpetual growth, which implies roughly 22.7 years of production against an 8.4-year proved reserve life, and the reserve-life model its own falsifier named as the test fired against it.
agreed_facts: Proved reserves at 2025-12-31 are 206,473 MMcfe (178,544 producing, 23,066 developed non-producing, 4,864 undeveloped) with PV-10 of $293.690m and a standardized measure of $266.326m, per the CG&A reserve report.

Pro forma FY2025 Cash Available for Distribution is $36.317m, struck after cash interest, cash taxes and cash preferred dividends; pro forma DD&A is $36.451m and pro forma net income is a loss of $32.330m.

Pro forma FY2025 net cash provided by operating activities is $9.533m and pro forma Q1 2026 operating cash flow is negative $10.714m; Adjusted EBITDA of $64.405m carries $21.795m of management-fee and $11.596m of transaction-cost add-backs.
The Company holds 22,996,579 OpCo Interests (86.0%), falling to 82.1% if the 1,250,000 earnout units issue; Class B carries votes and no economic rights.

Debt was repriced and extended at the IPO - Senior Notes from Adjusted Term SOFR + 6.50% to + 4.75%, maturity 2030-06-23 to 2031-05-20 - with the revolver undrawn and debt down from $231.425m actual to $75.0m as-adjusted, less an unreflected $6.3m April 2026 prepayment.
Contract value per Class A share is $4.86 / $5.71 / $6.83 against a price of $26.16, an annualised return of -21.37% / -19.53% / -17.45% over seven years.

On April 22, 2026, seven weeks before the IPO, the company concluded its FY2025 audited statements could no longer be relied upon, citing management-fee recording and acquisition cash misclassification, and identified material weaknesses in internal control.
No dividend has been declared as a public company and no 10-Q or 10-K has been filed since the 2026-06-10 IPO.
disputed_facts: Whether the proved reserve book is the right measure of economic life. hk holds that WhiteHawk owns minerals in fee and the 4.4% observed volume decline against a 13.75% producing decline proves unbooked inventory is materially offsetting depletion; klarman_asset_value and marks_credit_cycle value only what the reserve report books. This is unresolved and is the single largest open variable.
Whether 2.7x PV-10 is a premium or a normal clearing price for Appalachian minerals. Unresolved - the packet holds no comparable transactions of any kind.

Whether the credit-cycle seat should price commodity risk at all, given the contract already discounts at 9-12%. marks_credit_cycle recorded on the record that its vote is on price rather than credit.

value_range_per_share.basis: Sum of pdp_royalty_cash_stream (4.34/5.01/5.89) and non_producing_reserve_inventory (0.51/0.71/0.94), floored at zero for limited liability.
value_range_per_share.known_bias: Generous in two respects and conservative in one. It anchors on pre-tax PV-10 rather than the after-tax standardized measure, and it charges no recurring corporate overhead - capitalising $8m/yr over the 8.4-year life at 10% would remove about $1.57 per share. Against that, senior claims are overstated by the unreflected $6.3m prepayment, worth about +$0.23 per share.

entry_ranges.note: Entry prices are derived from the decision-grade contract and are not a capital instruction. The current price of $26.16 is roughly 12x the 15% base hurdle entry.

recommendation.rationale: Two of three raters reject and the third votes watch; no rater approves and no rater found a positive-return case in any scenario. The committee's finding is narrow and should be read narrowly: it rejects the security at $26.16, not the business. WhiteHawk is a real royalty book with defensively repriced debt and premier operators on its acreage. What the committee cannot do is underwrite a price roughly 4.6x the evidenced asset value on a packet that could not answer two of three decision-material questions. The committee does not size capital and does not decide; this routes to human_decision.json.
conditions_that_would_reopen: An acreage and undrilled-location census quantifying inventory beyond the 206,473 MMcfe proved book.
The first 10-Q as a public company, which would end the pro-forma-only evidence base and permit a prior-period diff.
A declared dividend policy, which would convert the undeclared distribution assumption into a committed payout.
A material price decline toward the $2.15-$2.93 hurdle band.

dissent_preserved.dissent: The proved reserve book is a booking convention bounded by SEC rules and the five-year PUD window, not an inventory census. Pro forma volumes fell only 4.4% against a producing book implying 13.14-13.75% decline, so roughly 9 points of annual volume is already being replaced by new wells converting unbooked inventory. If that inventory is large, the correct model is a perpetual royalty on a drilling program, 2.7x PV-10 is ordinary for the asset class, and this contract's base is far too low. The research loop could not size it, so this remains the strongest argument against the committee's conclusion.
dissent_preserved.chair_response: Recorded and not overridden. The committee valued what is booked because that is what is evidenced; it did not conclude that unbooked acreage is worthless. That distinction is material and must survive into the human decision.

dissent_preserved.dissent: Raised downside_control from 2 to 3 on the recovered debt terms and stated on the record that its vote is on price rather than credit, since the contract already prices cyclical risk in a 9-12% discount rate. Separately flagged that both components hold the SEC price deck fixed across all three cases, so for an unhedged royalty the stated range is narrower than the true distribution; applying the packet's own price elasticity, a return to the $2.13/MMBtu deck would put Class A asset value near or below $2 per share - a downside case that exists in no component of this contract.
dissent_preserved.chair_response: Accepted as a real limitation of the contract. The absence of a commodity-price case is a structural gap in the range, not a rater disagreement, and it belongs in the monitoring plan.

dissent_preserved.dissent: Held that the packet is sufficient to determine asset value even though it cannot explain the market multiple, and noted that the omission of capitalised corporate overhead makes the valuation too generous rather than too harsh.
dissent_preserved.chair_response: The evidence-sufficiency split - one rater calling the packet sufficient, two not - is preserved rather than reconciled. It reflects a genuine difference about what each lens needs, not a factual dispute.

evidence_gaps_blocking_decision_grade_us: Unbooked mineral inventory is unquantified and unresolvable from this packet.
No covenant tests, restricted-payment basket or headroom for the Senior Notes and Revolving Credit Facility.
No comparable transactions and no independent adversarial examination; the frozen adversarial pass reconciled no filings and scanned no disclosures.
Remediation status of the identified material weaknesses in internal control is unestablished.
The prospectus's 24.8% versus 28.8% OpCo ownership discrepancy remains unreconciled.

First declared dividend and stated payout policy.
FY2026 10-K reserve report: proved reserves, PV-10, SEC price deck, and any negative revisions.
Remediation of the identified material weaknesses in internal control.

price_review_thresholds: Price at or below $6.83, the contract high case, warrants a full re-underwrite.
Price at or below $2.93 clears the 10% base hurdle.
Price above $35 without a reserve or production catalyst widens the unexplained multiple and should trigger a review of the unbooked-acreage question.
thesis_break_conditions: Reported CAFD above $42.0m, implying a producing decline shallower than the reserve report supports.
PV-10 above $500m (above $0.00242m per MMcfe) on the next reserve report.
Blended PV-10 unit value outside $1.00-$2.00 per Mcfe.
